title.narrative: Delegation Agreement with the Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA)

description.narrative: The Delegation Agreement grants a contribution from the EU to the DBSA for the implementation of the Infrastructure Investment Programme of South Africa (IIPSA) to the DBSA. The Agreement is covered by an overarching Financing Agreement between the EC and the SA government on the IIPSA.
